# Binary dependency notices

The binary includes Go runtime/standard-library code (BSD-3-Clause),
github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2 (MIT), and golang.org/x/sys (BSD-3-Clause).
Upstream license texts are reproduced here. Dependency versions are pinned in
go.mod and go.sum. Inspect `go version -m` on an artifact for its toolchain and
module versions. Recheck this inventory when dependencies change.
Test-only dependencies retain their upstream licenses and are not shipped.
